name: Skeleton
description: There is an animated skeleton here, who has for a weapon ten very sharp bony fingers.

name: Killer Bunny
description: You see swimming towards you a large rabbit with soft tan fur and a maniacal look in his pink eyes.

name: Wandering Minstrel Eye
description: You see floating three feet off the ground a huge disembodied eye.  It has no limbs, but from somewhere it is humming a song:  A Wandering Minstrel Eye.

name: Black Knight
description: You see a knight carrying a sword and outfitted in black chain mail.  He does not look friendly!

name: Priest
description: You see a man dressed in flowing religious garb.  He is wearing chain mail and is carrying a mace.

name: High Priest
description: You see a man dressed in the robes of a high priest.  He wears chain mail and has a morning star in his hand.

name: Blacksmith
description: You see a huge, burly man wearing the apron and gloves of a blacksmith.  He carries a hammer in his right hand that has strange red stains on it.

name: Gypsy
description: You see a carefree Gypsy here, playing an accordion.  His music is so lovely that you almost fail to notice the wicked broad sword lying next to him.

name: Larcenous Lil
description: You see your old pal, Larcenous Lil! She thanks you for freeing her. She is rubbing her wrists from where the chains cut into her skin, but she otherwise seems unharmed.

name: Minotaur
description: You see before you a minotaur, straight out of the legends with his bulls head, human body, and a very nasty battle axe.  He does not smell very clean.

name: Slippery Sven
description: You see your old pal, Slippery Sven! He thanks you for freeing him. He is rubbing his wrists from where the chains cut into his skin, but he otherwise seems unharmed.
